title: Calendar invites update and cancel in the booker's calendar when a booking moves or is cancelled

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21: buildBookingIcsBase64 sends METHOD:PUBLISH with no ORGANIZER, ATTENDEE, LOCATION or SEQUENCE. A cancellation mails no .ics, and a reschedule creates a new booking id, so the new invite has a new UID and the old event stays in the booker's calendar next to the new one. Fix: METHOD:REQUEST with a stable UID across a reschedule (carry the first booking id), SEQUENCE bumps, and a METHOD:CANCEL attachment on cancel.

DONE 2026-11-21: booking invites are METHOD:REQUEST with ORGANIZER (the Space name, mailto the EMAIL_FROM no-reply address), ATTENDEE (the booker), SEQUENCE, STATUS and an optional LOCATION (omitted until BOOK-010 gives a service a place), with lines folded at 75 octets. The UID is the first booking of the rescheduled_from chain and SEQUENCE its depth, so a move updates the one event. Cancellation emails attach a METHOD:CANCEL booking.ics with the same UID and SEQUENCE + 1; when the caller does not name the booking (the member cancelBooking path) the notice finds the newest cancelled booking of that booker at that start. sendBookingCancelledEmail takes an optional icsBase64.
